description: The 'dss_codeenvs_live' dataset provides detailed information about the live code environments used within the Dataiku DSS platform. This dataset is essential for managing and understanding the various coding environments available for data science projects. It includes information about the environment names, programming languages used, deployment modes, and the owners responsible for these environments. Additionally, it provides technical details such as the Python interpreter version, core package sets, and the file paths where these environments are stored. The dataset also includes URLs for accessing these environments directly through the Dataiku platform. This information is crucial for administrators and data scientists who need to manage and optimize their coding environments, ensuring compatibility and efficiency in their data projects. The dataset's structure allows for easy querying and analysis, making it a valuable resource for maintaining the integrity and performance of data science workflows.
shortDesc: Dataset of live code environments in Dataiku DSS platform.

columns.name: code_env_name
columns.comment: Name of the code environment, identifies environment.

columns.name: code_env_lang
columns.comment: Programming language used in the environment, e.g., Python, R.

columns.name: deployment_mode
columns.comment: Mode of deployment, e.g., DESIGN_MANAGED, DSS_INTERNAL.

columns.name: owner
columns.comment: Email of the environment owner, identifies responsible person.

columns.name: python_interpreter
columns.comment: Version of Python interpreter used, e.g., PYTHON36.

columns.name: core_packages_set
columns.comment: Set of core packages, e.g., PANDAS10, AUTO.

columns.name: path
columns.comment: File path to the code environment, storage location.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL to access the code environment, direct link.
